Travelers arrive here in off-road vehicles while making their way from Uyuni toward the Chilean border. Stopping at the lagoon offers a chance to see how the colors of the water and surrounding slopes change throughout the day. The wind and high altitude make warm clothes useful even under bright sunshine. The cover image shows neighboring Laguna Verde along the same route.

Laguna Capitán lies in the Chaco and is a place for birdwatching. Saline water reaches its pale shores, while the shallows attract waterbirds and other shoreline wildlife. Flamingos are among the birds found in the area.

The lagoon adds an open waterscape to the Chaco's dry forest scenery. Its shores, reflections and birds moving through the shallow water are all worth observing. A visit is often combined with an introduction to the Mennonite communities and Filadelfia. Together, they offer an opportunity to experience the natural and cultural sides of the region on a single trip.

At the shore of Laguna Capri, you may want to put down your backpack, sit beside the water and wait for the clouds to reveal Fitz Roy. The blue lagoon lies amid Patagonian forest, with granite peaks rising beyond the opposite shore. In calm weather, their silhouettes are reflected in the water; the wind can turn that mirror into fine ripples within minutes.

The trail begins near El Chaltén, in Los Glaciares National Park. The first climbs open up views of the Las Vueltas River valley before the route winds among the trees. This is an accessible introduction to hiking in Patagonia: the walk is shorter than the longer trek to Laguna de los Tres, and the forested shore gives you time to take in the mountains. Even so, it is a genuine mountain trail with both ascents and descents.

On Ada Tours' “Argentina, Chile and Beautiful Patagonia” itinerary, the walk to Laguna Capri takes half a day after the transfer to El Chaltén. It gives travelers a feel for local distances and helps them prepare for further hikes. Whether Fitz Roy is visible depends on the weather, so it is worth allowing time to wait by the water even if the weather in town is sunny. The shore, forest and trail are rewarding in their own right.
